featured_reviews.review_text:
Gurukrupa Hall is a versatile venue known for hosting various events, including weddings, parties, conferences, and cultural gatherings. Situated in a convenient location, it boasts spacious halls that cater to different capacities, allowing for both intimate gatherings and larger celebrations.

Renowned for its accommodating staff and well-maintained facilities, Gurukrupa Hall offers customizable arrangements to suit diverse event needs. The hall's amenities often include audiovisual equipment, ample parking space, and catering services, contributing to a hassle-free event experience.

However, while praised for its ambiance and services, occasional feedback regarding maintenance and scheduling issues has surfaced. Nonetheless, its strategic location, adaptable spaces, and accommodating staff continue to make it a favored choice for those seeking a venue for their special occasions or corporate events.

featured_reviews.name: Antidot Addict
featured_reviews.review_text:
Poojari Banquet Hall is one of the best venues in the area for hosting celebrations, community gatherings, and special occasions. The moment you walk in, the ambience feels warm and welcoming — a perfect balance of elegance and comfort.

The hall itself is spacious, well-ventilated, and beautifully maintained. Whether it’s a wedding, engagement, birthday party, or cultural event, the layout is designed to accommodate large gatherings without feeling overcrowded. The lighting setup adds a festive glow, and the décor possibilities are endless — you can keep it simple or go grand, and it still looks stunning.

The management team and staff deserve special mention. They’re polite, organized, and always ready to help. From planning the seating arrangement to managing timing and cleanliness, everything runs smoothly. Their coordination with decorators, caterers, and sound teams makes event planning stress-free and efficient.

The food service was another highlight — fresh, well-prepared, and served on time. The catering area is hygienic, and the staff ensures everything stays orderly even when the crowd is large.

Parking is also well-managed, which is a big plus for any large event. The location is easy to access, and guests can arrive without confusion or long delays.

Overall, Poojari Banquet Hall delivers a perfect combination of space, service, and ambience. It’s ideal for those who want a smooth, beautiful, and memorable experience. Highly recommended for any function where quality and hospitality matter.

featured_reviews.name: Mountainbachha
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently hosted an event at Regency Banquet and had an absolutely wonderful experience. The staff deserves special appreciation — they were extremely polite, attentive, and well-coordinated throughout the function. From the planning stage to the final wrap-up, everything was handled smoothly and professionally, which made the entire experience stress-free for us.
The food was truly outstanding. Every dish was fresh, flavourful, and beautifully presented. Our guests kept complimenting the taste and variety, which says a lot about the quality of their catering. It’s rare to find food that pleases people of all age groups, but Regency managed to do just that.
The ambiance of the banquet hall is another highlight. The decor is elegant yet warm, creating a very comforting and welcoming vibe. The lighting, cleanliness, and overall setup added a touch of class without feeling over the top.
Overall, Regency Banquet exceeded our expectations in every way — excellent service, delicious food, and a lovely atmosphere. Highly recommended for anyone looking to host a memorable and hassle-free event. Definitely a 5-star experience!

featured_reviews.name: SANJIV RAI
featured_reviews.review_text:
Good place for small wedding, it can not handle anywhere more than 150 guests. There is no dedicated parking. Staff is good at reception till their work timing, no assistance post that.
Food was good but we did lot of tasting and menu fixing to make sure it was good.
There were powercuts and generator is slow to load and ends quickly. Power backup needs to be fixed.

Decoration was not upto the point and if late night wedding then tea and other service is negligible.

Cleaning crew is also questionable and washrooms are difficult to navigate and not so clean.

Overall good for small functions.

featured_reviews.name: Roshan Hegde
featured_reviews.review_text:
Regency Banquet Hall holds some of the most beautiful memories of my life. I have celebrated multiple functions here — from my personal engagement and mehndi to today’s very special occasion, my wife’s baby shower. Every single event has been flawlessly executed.
The entire management team is outstanding. Their food has never failed to impress me, my family, or my friends — consistently delicious and honestly at par with an à la carte experience. Quality, taste, and presentation have always been top-notch.
A special kudos to Shashidhar Shetty and his team for running such a wonderful chain with professionalism, warmth, and attention to detail. Regency Banquet Hall will always be my first choice for celebrations and a place I recommend wholeheartedly.

featured_reviews.name: Mrunali Pawar
featured_reviews.review_text: Staff is polite. Food quality is average. Starters were good, since they are not very spicy even kids can enjoy eating starters.

featured_reviews.name: Govind Rawat
featured_reviews.review_text: This venue is great for weddings and parties, but there's room for improvement. The bathrooms need to be cleaner, and the logic behind locating the ladies' bathroom on the third floor and the gents' on the second floor is puzzling. The ambiance and food are good, but the service needs about 30% improvement. I appreciate the security measure of asking for a wedding card for entry, but it would be helpful if the venue clearly indicated which floor is which to avoid confusion. Overall, it's an okay location, but some tweaks are necessary."

featured_reviews.name: Tejasvi
featured_reviews.review_text:
We booked Tanya Banquet Hall in October for our wedding on 7th March and Haldi on 5th March. We finalized this venue because the staff member handling our booking at that time was very cooperative, explained everything in detail, arranged food tasting, discussed breakfast preferences, and verbally committed early access and buffer time after 3:30 p.m. Based on those discussions, we proceeded with confidence.
It is important to mention that the current female staff member who later handled our case was also present in the office during our original booking discussions in October, seated beside the earlier staff member. However, during our recent visit, she denied awareness of those discussions and commitments.
A few days before the wedding, we were informed that the previous staff member had left. When we visited to clear the remaining 90% payment (which we paid voluntarily without receiving any reminder call), (but I got call from Tania banquet one month back asking that I had an enquiry for wedding which I told them that I already booked them and they didn't even know this because they don't have proper records and now when the wedding is on the corners the female staff said she tried calling me but it was unreachable seriously??)several earlier commitments were denied on the grounds that they were “not written.”
Before verifying records, we were repeatedly told that breakfast was not included and that buffer time was not committed. The staff member mentioned that a notebook exists where detailed menus of clients are recorded, but at that time she was unable to locate it. Despite not referring to the written records, conclusions were made that breakfast was not part of our package. Later, when certain arrangements were agreed upon, they were repeatedly described as a “favor.”
We respectfully believe that previously discussed and documented arrangements should not be presented as favors, especially when significant payments have already been made.
When we asked for acknowledgement of our cheque payment and requested a signature confirming corrected timing on the bill, this was initially refused. We were repeatedly told that verbal discussions do not count and that nothing additional would be signed.
The overall interaction felt dismissive and uncooperative during a very sensitive time just days before our wedding. Proper documentation, record management, and professional communication are extremely important in the wedding industry, particularly when staff transitions occur.
I already spread this situation in my family and friends and warned them to not book tania banquet hall which has such unprofessional rude egoist female staff also if you book them they don't even have your wedding details like menu and other discussions because they record this in a book which gets lost during your wedding time and they will deny everything plus they don't even know your menu
It's better to book old banquet halls in market who are really professional and cooperative and know how indian weddings work and understand everything and fullfil their commitments

Your female staff was not cooperative, unprofessional, denied everything quoted to us without checking records which was not found by her

Reminder:- we are the ones paying but it seems your female staff has more attitude like we literally borrowed something from her ....

For future advice change your female staff or improve your management( we don't have extra money kept in our bank accounts to pay you so you can spoil our big days)
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
Dear Tejasvi,

Thank you for sharing your detailed feedback. We sincerely apologize that your experience did not meet expectations during your wedding and Haldi events.

We regret the communication gaps, record-keeping issues, and coordination challenges you faced with our team. This is not the standard of professionalism we aim to provide, especially for such important occasions.

Your concerns have been noted and shared with our management for serious review, particularly regarding staff transitions, documentation practices, and client communication.

We truly value your input and will work on improving our processes. We hope for an opportunity to serve you better in the future.

Thank you,
Tania Banquet

featured_reviews.review_text:
We had booked 2 functions in Tania Banquet for our Haldi on 5th March 2026 and Wedding on 7th March 2026 ,

Firstly we had a communication with the manager named sandesh in the month of Oct-2025, we were happy with the quote and food and all the other stuff like timings , decor and DJ and paid a token amount for booking

Later we came to know that the above manager has left the job and a lady was supposed to manage the stuff

Now , this lady had never called me before 15 days of the function, On going upfront by myself I had visited the office for the remaining payment before some days of the function, there we came to know the real management lack

Points where management lacked just before couples of days the wedding
1. No proper handover was done if the staff is living the office.
2. Lady was least bother while we were talking to her .
3. Commitment for buffer time of 1 hr was confirmed verbally with the earlier manager but the lady at a crucial time was denying from those commitments.
4. When I had asked for my record for food menu(noting book) they failed to present in front of us(seems they might lost the record,very bad impression about the management)

At the time of haldi function the food was not good, our some guest suffered a stomach issue.
4 times the electricity got cut off and it took a lot of time for generator backup which delayed our function and guests felt uncomfortable.

At the time of wedding in the Morning again light was not there which delayed our wedding rituals to start and created panic moment for our family but inspite of their mistake our functions got delayed but still they charged us 10k for extension of 1 hr by us that to for taking pics and some shoots
One more thing our guest had also given a review regarding the food those who got a hair in the palak Puri

Lastly when the time was completed they had switched off the AC and some lights.
Because of some shoot and rituals we got an hr delay to exit the hall, for that 1 hr they have charged extra funds from us instead of this they should have been sorry for spoiling our function but shamelessly they said we will deduct 5k just pay 5k out of 10k worst banquet hall and management ever.

They offer excellent doorstep services, including pickup and delivery. If you have a busy schedule and can't visit the shop, they will easily come to you!
Their service is truly impressive, and they offer great discounts to first-time customers. 'Fabric Spa' is excellent for shoes, curtains, and carpets—you should definitely give it a try; they also provide great service for workwear.

featured_reviews.name: Pramod Jadhav
featured_reviews.review_text:
नालासोपारा वेस्ट मध्ये प्राईम लोकेशन मध्ये हा हॉल आहे हॉलची खासियत अशी आहे कि ओपन हॉल पण आहे आणि इंडोर हॉल पण आहे आणि डेकोरेशन अतिशय सुंदर पद्धतीने बनवून भेटेल.
आणि कॅटरिंग विशाल दादा यांची आहे जेवण छान आणि टेस्टी बनवल जातं.
आणि हॉलचे मालक श्री विनोद दादा आणि त्यांचे भाऊ बंटी  दादा खूप सपोर्ट करणारे आहेत .
मी सजेस्ट करतो पार्टी लग्न कार्य असेल तर तुम्ही नक्की वनराज हॉल ला भेट घ्या तुमच्या सोयीनुसार सगळं काही भेटेल
featured_reviews.review_translated_text:
This hall is in a prime location in Nalasopara West. The specialty of the hall is that there is both an open hall and an indoor hall and the decoration is made in a very beautiful way.
And the catering is by Vishal Dada, the food is made nice and tasty.
And the owner of the hall, Mr. Vinod Dada and his brother Bunty Dada are very supportive.
I suggest that if you have a party or wedding function, you should definitely visit Vanraj Hall. You will find everything according to your convenience.
